order: Address four findings raised by the latest review pass, while confirming that all five prior-round closures still hold. Change the touches lint to compare individual elements instead of a comma-joined string that is prone to false collisions. Make the glob matcher replicate the line-terminator character classes of the regular expression it replaced exactly, with no deviation. Have checkout startup sweep any abandoned worktrees still on disk, since pruning alone only clears registrations whose directory is already missing; live in-process checkouts must remain exempt from that sweep in every case. Correct future review orders so they enumerate every commit in their pinned range rather than overclaiming a single commit — the range should not collapse to one entry when more than one commit is in scope. Record the review verdict verbatim in the roster, and keep the tranche marked as open pending the next review pass.
claims: The touches lint now compares elements rather than a collision-prone comma join; the glob matcher replicates the retired regular expression's line-terminator classes exactly; checkout startup sweeps abandoned worktrees still on disk, since pruning alone only clears missing-directory registrations, while exempting live in-process checkouts; and future review orders enumerate every commit in their pinned range. The verdict was recorded verbatim. Suites: router 135, verifier 94, registry 31, full CI-equivalent run green.
